title: Implement configurable link patterns
body:
## Summary

- Implement configurable `link` patterns using either a bare regex or structured syntax.
- Preserve the built-in URL matcher as the lowest-priority matcher while allowing `link-url = false` to disable only the default URL behavior.
- Add support for configurable actions, highlight behavior, modifier parsing, clearing configured links, and config formatting.
- Add focused tests for bare regexes, structured link definitions, modifier parsing, priority ordering, and clearing links.
- Use general-purpose URI examples in the config documentation.

## AI

- Generated by Codex, and briefly human reviewed though I'm pretty unfamiliar with this codebase

## Motivation

The `link` config option existed but could not be configured. This enables users to define custom link matchers without coupling the implementation to a specific URI scheme.

## Testing

- `zig fmt --check src/config/Config.zig`
- `git diff --check`
- Ran a debug build and verified a link config
